caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, menma, naruto fish cake, and nori, arranged neatly in a blue-and-white patterned bowl. Warm, even lighting highlights the dish against a wooden background.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface beneath the bowl.
The chashu pork is a seared, pinkish-brown slice with visible fat marbling and black pepper specks on its surface.
The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, and irregularly shaped with a slightly crinkled, textured surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and garnishes.
Menma bamboo shoots appear glossy, tan-brown, with segmented, slightly curved shapes and visible surface ridges.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern, smooth glazed surface, and raised decorative rim.
Naruto fish cake: round, pale pink swirl center, creamy white outer ring, smooth surface with slight sheen.
